name: working_capital_cash_release_purchases_linked_payables
question_template: Revenue is {REV} USD per year and cost of sales is {COGS_PCT} percent of revenue; both stay unchanged. Use a {DAYS}-day year for every days ratio. Receivable days are measured on revenue, inventory days on cost of sales, and payable days on purchases. In the base year inventory was flat, so base-year purchases equal cost of sales. A working-capital program cuts receivable days by {DSO_CUT} days (a negative cut means receivable days rise), moves inventory days from {DIO_OLD} to {DIO_NEW}, and moves payable days from {DPO_OLD} to {DPO_NEW}. Purchases in the program year equal cost of sales plus the change in the inventory balance from base to target. Cash released equals the fall in receivables plus the fall in inventory plus the rise in payables, each measured as base balance versus target balance. Compute the net cash released by the program, in USD.

slots.description: Cash released by the change in the receivables balance.
Cash released by the change in the inventory balance.
Purchases in the program year after the inventory change.
Rise in the payables balance from base to target.

program:
from fractions import Fraction

def solve():
    rev = Fraction(P["REV"])
    cogs = rev * Fraction(P["COGS_PCT"], 100)
    days = Fraction(P["DAYS"])
    dso_cut = Fraction(P["DSO_CUT"])
    dio_old = Fraction(P["DIO_OLD"])
    dio_new = Fraction(P["DIO_NEW"])
    dpo_old = Fraction(P["DPO_OLD"])
    dpo_new = Fraction(P["DPO_NEW"])

    receivables_release = dso_cut * rev / days

    inv_old = dio_old * cogs / days
    inv_new = dio_new * cogs / days
    inventory_release = inv_old - inv_new

    purchases = cogs + (inv_new - inv_old)

    ap_old = dpo_old * cogs / days
    ap_new = dpo_new * purchases / days
    payables_financing = ap_new - ap_old

    final = receivables_release + inventory_release + payables_financing
    return {
        "final": final,
        "receivables_release": receivables_release,
        "inventory_release": inventory_release,
        "program_year_purchases": purchases,
        "payables_financing": payables_financing,
    }
